description: Autolinee Toscane - Emg Extraurbano Uninone Comuni del Casentino: GTFS transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by Autolinee Toscane - Emg Extraurbano Uninone Comuni del Casentino. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Caprese Michelangelo, Tuscany, Italy. Coverage: Caprese Michelangelo, Tuscany, Italy. The Mobility Database lists 1 GTFS schedule feed for this provider (Caprese Michelangelo, Tuscany, Italy). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Headsigns, Route Colors, Shapes. At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the Mobility Database listing (licence field empty). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
